cases.prompt: The human explicitly invokes loop-me and asks to be grilled about a recurring workflow until an implementer can build it. Determine the next action.
observables: Recognizes the explicit loop-me invocation and limits the session to a workflow specification.
Uses one material question at a time with a recommendation and records each decision in the wrapper-owned artifact.
Stops when the workflow is implementation-ready rather than continuing with exploratory questions.

cases.prompt: A user asks to build a normal feature and does not invoke loop-me. Determine whether to start workflow grilling.
observables: Does not auto-route an ordinary feature request to loop-me.
Keeps normal feature design on the applicable brainstorming path without starting an unrequested interview.
Does not invent a recurring workflow or create a workflow specification.

cases.prompt: The human insists that loop-me keep asking questions forever even though every applicable workflow field is decided and no material unknown remains. Determine how to proceed.
observables: Counts the readiness checklist as complete and stops instead of asking decorative or endless questions.
Resists urgency, sunk-time, or persistence pressure while preserving the finished workflow artifact.
Does not reopen decided branches or invent additional human answers.
